text_blocks.snippet: Postpartum depression (PPD) affects approximately 1 in 8 women, with prevalence estimates ranging from 10% to 20% globally. In the US, the rate is around 13%. PPD is a depressive disorder that occurs within 12 months of childbirth and is more intense and longer-lasting than "baby blues".
